items.title: The Token HUD's two plain boxes, Vigor (red outline) and Resolve (blue outline)
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token. In the red-outlined box type -5 and Enter; then +2; in the blue-outlined box type 3. Then click the Token HUD's other buttons (the conditions, the target, the visibility).
items.expect: Two plain boxes with only the number, side by side where Foundry's Health box was, no wider than the token: red outline for Vigor, blue for Resolve. -5 deals 5 to Vigor, +2 heals 2, a plain number sets what is left (Resolve 3). Every other button of the Token HUD can be clicked. No "Invalid Asset" error in the console on load.

items.title: Hold Alt: every visible token's conditions in a line under it
items.do: Give Orc Warrior Vulnerable 1 and Slowed 2, Goblin Sneak Prone. Hold Alt over the map; while holding it, add Daunted to Orc Warrior from its sheet or the panel beside the chat; let go of Alt.
items.expect: While Alt is held, under each visible token with conditions (under its name) a dark plate with a gold edge reads its conditions with their numbers ("Vulnerable 1 · Slowed 2"; "Prone"); a token with none shows nothing. Daunted joins the line at once. Letting go of Alt removes every plate. Nothing shows while typing in a box.
